column3: That girl... our eyes even met. And yet...
Kuroneko was definitely looking this way earlier. In spite of that, she just turned and briskly walked away with that expressionless face...
J-just, just that you noticed us too, right? But now you're just leaving...
That's not the kind of word you hear everyday. Is she talking about me...?
I can feel this area welling up with negative energy. Don't speak of such trivial things.
Hm, it's gone already. Very well, we shall speak.
Y-Yeaah... See, at first glance, you may have thought it was a Galge-eqsue situation but...
I don't think this merits listening.
Wait, I didn't even say anything yet.
No. It's important, so I'll say it as many times as needed. Right now, you are uncouth. There's no doubt about it.
Jeez, Kuroneko sure is in "wrath" mode today!
